GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG720.4 (14 Oct 47) CTS-W
(SCAPIN - 1801)
APO 500
14 October 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Quarantine Installations and Procedures
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, AG 567.
(1 Oct 47)PH, subject as above (SCAPIN 1787).
2. In addition to the ports of entry listed in reference, the ports of Kagoshima and Hakata are designated as ports of entry but for Japanese shipping only.
3. The Japanese Government will provide quarantine services at these ports of entry, as required by the Commanding General, Eighth Army, for handling Japanese shipping.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
